definition: Children are manually chosen independently checkable qualifications, returned/written/requested outcomes, ordered relations and branch/failure dispositions. Finite set-membership and one ordered relation are each one meaning; the count is not inferred from source lines, syntax or semicolons. IDs do not certify execution. Common meanings are factored once with explicit applicability.

shared_meanings.meaning: Dispatch has no common ordinary-active, MoldBreaker, fainted, species, forced or ability-nonempty guard; each actual consumer owns its gates.
Only nil invokes fallback; false and0 remain actual return values.
Direct notification forwards the incidental callback result; it is not a generic domain success result.
No common rescue/ensure or transaction rollback surrounds the registered callback; reached writes can remain after later callback, logger or presentation failure.
Most bodies have no local UI cancellation. EmergencyExit explicitly has negative replacement selection; upstream refusal/cancel prevents the later callback and is not retroactive rollback.
Calculation changes precede final rounding and actual HP/hit submission; slots and order are distinct.
HP recovery/damage requests use the local quotient before the central rounding/minimum/clamp; canHeal, indirect-damage permission and contact-effect permission are distinct.
Lookup/trigger normalize an id-responsive non-Symbol input; raw add keeps its key; AbilityHandlerHash is an empty subclass.
Primitive add checks Proc/Hash or supplied block before assignment; nil key is not added. Accepted Hash need not be callable. The historical optional compatibility choice remains unadopted.
Copy resolves the current source immediately, misses without destination writes, and shares the resolved object; replacing the source later does not retarget the destination.
The fixed primary has48 families, two empty. 263 registration statements/267 expanded pairs are identity structure, not the semantic denominator.

control_profiles.RETURN: Keep the same named input; compare an admitted local predicate assignment with each independently refused assignment, holding earlier gates fixed. Missing result follows the exact family fallback, never an assumed success.
control_profiles.CONTAINER: Use an initial changed-slot multiplier1.0/stage+1/base accuracy80 as applicable. Admit the listed predicates, then independently negate each predicate (threshold equality and adjacent value where stated); unchanged slots are controls. This is a local predicate fixture, not an executed move.
control_profiles.NOTIFICATION: Use the written ordinary prefix with all named gates admitted. Independently refuse each explicit gate at its documented position; for draws compare29/30 or49/50 as named. For nested failure stop immediately after each listed committed effect and retain only that prefix. No callback-wide rollback/ensure or extra UI cancel is assumed.
control_profiles.COPY: Register A with callable X, copy source A to destination B, replace A with Y: B still resolves X. With missing A no destination is registered. This is a static interpretation, NOT_EXECUTED.
control_profiles.UNCONDITIONAL: Use the named input unchanged in all other fields; e.g weight101→202/50, weight1→1 for LightMetal; critical stage0→1 or fixed−1. Absence of a local predicate does not remove caller gates.
